actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1d6+2 piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1d6+2 slashing damage.

monsters.name: Ghast
monsters.notes: Medium undead. Darkvision 60 ft. Condition immunities: charmed, exhaustion, poisoned. Stench (DC 10 CON nearby or poisoned). Turn Defiance (allies within 30 ft. have advantage vs. Turn Undead).

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 2d8+3 piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 2d6+3 slashing damage. If the target isn't an undead, DC 10 Constitution save or be paralyzed for 1 minute (repeat save at end of each turn).

monsters.name: Polar Bear
monsters.notes: Large beast. Swim 30 ft. Keen Smell.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The bear makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1d8+5 piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 2d6+5 slashing damage.

monsters.name: Will-o'-Wisp
monsters.languages: the languages it knew in life
monsters.resistances: acid, cold, fire, necrotic, thunder; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
monsters.notes: Tiny undead. Fly 50 ft. (hover); listed speed is its flying speed. Condition immunities: exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained, unconscious. Variable Illumination; Ephemeral; Incorporeal Movement.

actions.name: Shock
actions.description: Melee Spell Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 2d8 lightning damage.

actions.name: Invisibility
actions.description: The wisp and its light turn invisible until it attacks or uses Consume Life (it can't attack while invisible).

monsters.name: Werewolf
monsters.immunities: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered
monsters.notes: Medium humanoid (shapechanger). Hybrid/wolf form speed 40 ft. Shapechanger; Keen Hearing and Smell.

actions.name: Multiattack (Humanoid/Hybrid)
actions.description: The werewolf makes two attacks: one bite (hybrid only) and one claws or spear.

actions.name: Bite (Wolf/Hybrid Only)
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1d8+2 piercing damage. If the target is humanoid, DC 12 Constitution save or be cursed with werewolf lycanthropy.

actions.name: Claws (Hybrid Only)
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 2d4+2 slashing damage.

monsters.name: Minotaur
monsters.notes: Large monstrosity. Darkvision 60 ft. Charge; Labyrinthine Recall; Reckless.

actions.name: Charge
actions.description: If the minotaur moves at least 10 ft. straight toward a target and hits it with a gore on the same turn, the target takes an extra 2d8 piercing damage and, on a failed DC 14 Strength save, is pushed up to 10 ft. and knocked prone.

actions.name: Greataxe
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 2d12+4 slashing damage.

actions.name: Gore
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 2d8+4 piercing damage.

monsters.name: Basilisk
monsters.notes: Medium monstrosity. Darkvision 60 ft. Petrifying Gaze (a creature starting its turn within 30 ft. that meets the basilisk's eyes makes a DC 12 Constitution save or begins to turn to stone; on a second failure it is petrified).

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 2d6+3 piercing damage plus 2d8 poison damage.

monsters.name: Manticore
monsters.notes: Large monstrosity. Fly 50 ft. Tail Spike Regrowth (24 spikes, regrow after a long rest).

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The manticore makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws, or three with its tail spikes.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1d8+3 piercing damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1d6+3 slashing damage.

actions.name: Tail Spike
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 100/200 ft., one target. Hit: 1d8+3 piercing damage.

monsters.name: Hell Hound
monsters.notes: Medium fiend. Darkvision 60 ft. Keen Hearing and Smell; Pack Tactics.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1d8+3 piercing damage plus 2d6 fire damage.

actions.name: Fire Breath (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The hound exhales fire in a 15-foot cone. Each creature there makes a DC 12 Dexterity save, taking 6d6 fire damage on a failure, or half as much on a success.

monsters.name: Mummy
monsters.languages: the languages it knew in life
monsters.resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
monsters.notes: Medium undead. Darkvision 60 ft. Condition immunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, poisoned.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The mummy uses Dreadful Glare and makes one attack with its rotting fist.

actions.name: Rotting Fist
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 2d6+3 bludgeoning damage plus 3d6 necrotic damage. On a hit the target must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution save or be cursed with mummy rot (can't regain HP and max HP drops by 3d6 each day).

actions.name: Dreadful Glare
actions.description: The mummy targets one creature it can see within 60 ft. DC 11 Wisdom save or be frightened until the end of the mummy's next turn (if it fails by 5+, also paralyzed for the same duration).

monsters.name: Doppelganger
monsters.notes: Medium monstrosity (shapechanger). Condition immunities: charmed. Shapechanger; Ambusher; Surprise Attack (extra 3d6 on round 1). Read Thoughts.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The doppelganger makes two melee attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1d6+4 bludgeoning damage.

monsters.name: Veteran
monsters.notes: Medium humanoid. A hardened soldier or mercenary. Splint armor.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The veteran makes two longsword attacks. If it has a shortsword drawn, it can also make a shortsword attack.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1d8+3 slashing (1d10+3 two-handed).

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1d6+3 piercing damage.

actions.name: Heavy Crossbow
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, range 100/400 ft., one target. Hit: 1d10+1 piercing damage.

monsters.name: Ettin
monsters.notes: Large giant. Darkvision 60 ft. Two Heads (advantage vs. blinded/charmed/deafened/frightened/stunned/knocked unconscious); Wakeful.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The ettin makes two attacks: one with its battleaxe and one with its morningstar.

actions.name: Battleaxe
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 2d8+5 slashing damage.

actions.name: Morningstar
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 2d8+5 piercing damage.

monsters.name: Banshee
monsters.resistances: acid, fire, lightning, thunder; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
monsters.notes: Medium undead. Fly 40 ft. (hover); listed speed is its flying speed. Condition immunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained. Detect Life; Incorporeal Movement.

actions.name: Corrupting Touch
actions.description: Melee Spell Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3d6 necrotic damage.

actions.name: Wail (1/Day)
actions.description: The banshee releases a mournful wail (no effect on constructs and undead). Each creature within 30 ft. that can hear makes a DC 13 Constitution save or drops to 0 hit points; on a success it takes 3d6 psychic damage.

monsters.name: Hill Giant
monsters.notes: Huge giant.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The giant makes two greatclub attacks.

actions.name: Greatclub
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 3d8+5 bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Rock
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. Hit: 3d10+5 bludgeoning damage.

monsters.name: Gladiator
monsters.notes: Medium humanoid. A champion arena fighter. Brave.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The gladiator makes three melee attacks or two ranged attacks.

actions.name: Spear
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 2d6+4 piercing damage (melee two-handed).

actions.name: Shield Bash
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 2d4+4 bludgeoning damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, DC 15 Strength save or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Parry
actions.description: The gladiator adds 3 to its AC against one melee attack that would hit it (must see the attacker and wield a melee weapon).

monsters.name: Wyvern
monsters.notes: Large dragon. Fly 80 ft. Darkvision 60 ft.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The wyvern makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its claws or stinger. While flying it can use claws in place of one other attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. Hit: 2d6+4 piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 2d8+4 slashing damage.

actions.name: Stinger
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. Hit: 2d6+4 piercing damage, and DC 15 Constitution save or take 7d6 poison damage (half on success).

monsters.name: Chimera
monsters.notes: Large monstrosity. Fly 60 ft. Darkvision 60 ft.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The chimera makes three attacks: one with its bite, one with its horns, and one with its claws. When its fire breath is available, it can use it in place of its bite.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 2d6+4 piercing damage.

actions.name: Horns
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1d12+4 bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 2d6+4 slashing damage.

actions.name: Fire Breath (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The dragon head exhales fire in a 15-foot cone. Each creature there makes a DC 15 Dexterity save, taking 7d8 fire damage on a failure, or half as much on a success.

monsters.name: Young Green Dragon
monsters.notes: Large dragon. Fly 80 ft., swim 40 ft. Blindsight 30 ft., darkvision 120 ft. Condition immunities: poisoned. Amphibious.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The dragon makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 2d10+4 piercing damage plus 2d6 poison damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 2d6+4 slashing damage.

actions.name: Poison Breath (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The dragon exhales poisonous gas in a 30-foot cone. Each creature there makes a DC 14 Constitution save, taking 12d6 poison damage on a failure, or half as much on a success.

monsters.name: Young Red Dragon
monsters.notes: Large dragon. Climb 40 ft., fly 80 ft. Blindsight 30 ft., darkvision 120 ft.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The dragon makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 2d10+6 piercing damage plus 1d6 fire damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 2d6+6 slashing damage.

actions.name: Fire Breath (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The dragon exhales fire in a 30-foot cone. Each creature there makes a DC 17 Dexterity save, taking 16d6 fire damage on a failure, or half as much on a success.
